description: base state (wit=0, has_key absent): showIf-gated choices hidden
wit=5 makes ch_skill_req visible
has_key=true makes ch_flag_req visible
all conditions met: all choices visible
isEnd node: terminal choice visible, no onEnter effects
all showIf conditions fail: no visible choices
node with no choices field: visibleChoices is empty
onEnter effects returned but NOT applied to state (caller responsibility)
node showIf FAILS: entry resolves through a two-skip chain to n_real; the skipped nodes' onEnter never appears — only the RESOLVED node's effects are returned
node showIf PASSES: the gated entry node is shown as itself, id and effects intact
goto arrival at a gated node resolves the same way entry does — one skip walk, every arrival site
